title: Why does React re-render my component twice inside StrictMode?
body: I have a small counter component and every time I click the button the `console.log` inside the render body fires twice. I understand that React StrictMode intentionally double-invokes render in development — but my `useEffect` also fires twice, and my `fetch` is being duplicated.

title: Efficient keyset pagination over a 10M-row Postgres table with a composite index
body: I'm paginating a large audit table and OFFSET is killing us once the page number gets high. I have a composite index on (tenant_id, created_at) and I'd like to switch to a keyset approach, but tie-breaking on duplicate timestamps is giving me trouble.

title: TypeScript: narrowing a discriminated union inside an Array.filter callback
body: I have type Shape = Circle | Square and I want shapes.filter(s => s.kind === 'circle') to come back typed as Circle[]. It widens back to Shape[] unless I hand-write a type predicate.

title: Rust borrow checker rejects returning a reference out of a HashMap
body: I'm returning a &String from a function that looks up a key in a HashMap built inside the function body. The borrow checker rejects it with E0515: cannot return reference to local variable.

title: Docker build fails with “no space left on device” on GitHub Actions runners
body: Multi-stage build with a heavy node_modules layer. It works locally but the hosted runner runs out of disk during the export step.

title: CSS container queries never match when the component is reused in a sidebar
body: I want a card grid that reflows based on the width of its container rather than the viewport, because the same component is used inside a narrow sidebar and a full-width page.
